description: Demo fixture for the Monthly Revision page. Production should replace this with real sales/delivery actuals, user context and live monthly context feeds without changing the revision surface.

channel_performance.context: Search captured demand efficiently but query volume remains capped.
Prospecting cost per order drifted high.
Cashback and voucher-code partners beat forecast.
Video test delivery under target; keep as capped test.
Underdelivered against booked impression proxy - still measurement-led.

user_context: Planner note: June was weaker than expected after school term and travel disruption affected local response.
Client note: protect the Autumn/Winter and Black Friday-Christmas trading peak tentpole logic, but avoid scaling weak June digital tests without measurement.

monthly_context.weather: Warmer, drier summer weeks; outdoor attention improves but response attribution is weak.
monthly_context.sports: Football creative context continues, but no automatic budget movement without performance proof.
monthly_context.calendar: Summer holidays begin; review family messaging and local salience.

revision_rules: Freeze months before the selected revision month.
Use the approved annual plan as the baseline.
Reallocate the selected and remaining months only.
Prior-month underperformance reduces weak-evidence test channels unless user context explicitly protects them.
Affiliates and Google Search can receive modest uplift when prior-month sales index is strong, subject to saturation/cap warnings.
Revision output is a new plan version candidate requiring human approval.

channel_performance.context: Demand capture efficient but capped by query volume.

user_context: Planner note: protect Christmas trading-peak support and avoid stripping Google Search too aggressively.

monthly_context.weather: Colder, wetter evenings likely increase home media consumption.
monthly_context.sports: Winter sport context supports Linear Radio/YouTube adjacency checks.
monthly_context.calendar: Christmas and Black Friday trading-peak preparation; higher attention and higher clutter.

revision_rules: Protect the December Christmas trading peak.
Use stronger prior-month performance to support proven channels, but keep evidence gaps visible.
